ThingDef.label: 152mm Msta (direct fire)
ThingDef.description: A self-propelled 152mm howitzer configured for direct fire. High velocity, flat trajectory, requires line of sight.\n\nClick the mode button to rebuild as indirect fire variant.

li.gizmoDesc: Rebuild this turret for indirect fire mode (artillery arc)\nRequires 25+ cell range, fires over obstacles

ThingDef.label: 152mm Msta (indirect fire)
ThingDef.description: A self-propelled 152mm howitzer configured for indirect fire. Arcing trajectory, can fire over obstacles.\n\nClick the mode button to rebuild as direct fire variant.

li.gizmoDesc: Rebuild this turret for direct fire mode (flat trajectory)\nRequires line of sight, higher accuracy
